name: Base Box
code:
def make_base(self):
    shape = cq.Workplane('XY').box(self.length, self.width, self.height)
    self.box = shape
    self.model = shape

name: Add Holes
description: Adds four different holes to the corners of the box: a circle, a horizontal ellipse, a vertical ellipse, and a rectangle.
code:
def add_holes(self):
    top_face = self.box.faces('>Z').workplane()
    c1 = top_face.pushPoints([(self.circle_x, self.circle_y)]).circle(self.circle_radius).extrude(-self.height, combine=False)
    c2 = top_face.pushPoints([(self.h_ellipse_x, self.h_ellipse_y)]).ellipse(self.h_ellipse_rx, self.h_ellipse_ry).extrude(-self.height, combine=False)
    c3 = top_face.pushPoints([(self.v_ellipse_x, self.v_ellipse_y)]).ellipse(self.v_ellipse_rx, self.v_ellipse_ry).extrude(-self.height, combine=False)
    c4 = top_face.pushPoints([(self.rect_x, self.rect_y)]).rect(self.rect_w, self.rect_l).extrude(-self.height, combine=False)
    self.model = self.model.cut(c1).cut(c2).cut(c3).cut(c4)
